evidence_quote: Patients. Seven patients homozygous for Tangier disease (Pe. Lo., Pa. Lo., T. La., E. La., J. Mi., C. Mi., and C. No.) who came from four unrelated kindreds
note: Biochemical study; patients named individually with some per-patient data (e.g. Pe. Lo. surgery/transfusion, Pa. Lo. Table IV); previously described patients.

evidence_quote: Since the molecular defects underlying the profound HDL deficiency in IM and in Tangier disease are not known, a definitive statement regarding whether IM has Tangier disease cannot be made.
note: Close call: one patient with Tangier-like HDL deficiency and features, but the authors do not diagnose Tangier disease and no gene was studied.
